metadata.title: Network Mediation and Policy Enforcement

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enforcing institutional network access policies through mediation and controlled enforcement points.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Network policy decision, mediation, and enforcement platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Centralized policy decision with distributed network enforcement points.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Network policy decisions, enforcement actions, and mediation audit records.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Policy decision and enforcement are separated, centrally evaluated, and continuously applied, consistent with Zero Trust Architecture principles.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Network mediation and enforcement implement identity-aware, policy-driven access control consistent with Zero Trust Networking guidance.

metadata.remarks: Network Mediation and Policy Enforcement defines how network traffic is evaluated against institutional policy and how those decisions are enforced. This pattern separates policy decision logic from enforcement mechanisms and enables dynamic, identity- and context-aware control of network flows. It does not define access policy content, segmentation design, or resiliency behavior, which are addressed by related Secure Network patterns.

components.title: Policy Decision Point (PDP)
components.description: Centralized evaluation of network access requests against institutional policy.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid credentials to influence or bypass policy decisions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Centralized, authenticated policy decision prevents ad-hoc enforcement.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Evaluate access requests against defined policy before network enforcement.

components.title: Policy Enforcement Point (PEP)
components.description: Distributed enforcement of policy decisions on network traffic.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Disabling or bypassing security enforcement mechanisms.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Enforcement points ensure policy decisions are consistently applied.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce network boundary protection based on policy decisions.

components.title: Policy Mediation
components.description: Translation and coordination of policy decisions across heterogeneous enforcement points.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Traffic manipulation through inconsistent or incomplete policy enforcement.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Coordinated mediation ensures consistent enforcement across network controls.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ensure consistent information flow enforcement across policy domains.
